about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for PAR-hollow-pass's fixture staging (night-1 triage rank 4, scratchpad/night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md): tests/gauntlet/exec_parity.py parity_pair copied each side's frame but never imported it, staged no smoke-job/style smoke, and used no recovery for the darkroom.open image-switch limit -- 18 pairs (10 'not in library', 6 'fixture missing', 2 'smoke args are errors') and 1 frame-switch pair never really exercised the verb even though envelopes_match read true. Review fix round 2 (Opus, n1-harness-review.md section 1) found the first pass still shared ONE library frame between both sides (A-1: library_import's resume identity is (source_name, sha256), and both copies had the same name), re-imported per case (A-2: ~184 round trips per layer), never recorded a masked frame-switch relaunch (A-3/finding 7) or a failed fixture (A-4/A-5/finding 13), and had a trivially-true oracle (A-6). Fixed: distinct per-side source names, import once per session with cached destinations and a per-case sidecar reset (finding 4), frame_switch_relaunch recorded (both-sides -> needs_review), fixture_errors recorded, and the oracle below now asserts the actual substituted image path. Run by tests/gauntlet/test_exec_parity.py against fakes (FakeMcp/FakeDt from tests/gauntlet/test_session.py, and a minimal FakeSession for the staging helpers in isolation, same pattern as tests/gauntlet/test_exec_bulk.py).
